events.title: European Shares Poised For Cautious Open Amid AI Jitters
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly lower on Tuesday as investors await key U.S. inflation data and corporate earnings in the coming days for direction.

events.title: Australia Business Confidence Weakens For Third Straight Month: NAB
events.description: Australia's business sentiment deteriorated for the third straight month in September amid concerns about higher interest rates, global uncertainty and elevated fuel costs, monthly business survey results from the National Australia Bank showed Tuesday. The business sentiment index fell to -13 from -9 in August. At the same time, the business conditions index was unchanged at 1 point in September.

events.title: Indian Shares Sharply Higher As IT Stocks Surge On AI Slowdown Worries
events.description: Indian shares were sharply higher in early trade on Tuesday, with information stocks leading the surge as enthusiasm for artificial intelligence eased.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, reversing the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 8,800 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial and energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Tuesday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, on spiking crude oil prices and supply concerns amid continued escalation in the Middle East conflict in violation of the Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire." Technology and semiconductor stocks are taking a hit amid mounting concerns over AI valuations and Chinese competition.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher At Open; IT Stocks In Focus As AI Trade Falters
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening higher on Tuesday, with information technology stocks likely to be in focus as enthusiasm for artificial intelligence eased.

events.title: Mild Upside Tipped For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market headed south again on Monday, one session after ending the two-day losing streak in which it had lost more than 160 points or 2.5 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just shy of the 5,940-point plateau although it may see at least a technical rebound on Tuesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply lower on Tuesday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 tumbling 2.4 percent to well below the 67,400 level, with weakness in technology partially offset by gains in automakers and financial stocks.

events.title: Rally May Stall For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, gathering almost 500 points or 2 percent along the way. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,270-point plateau although it may open in the red on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Tuesday, reversing the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 8,800 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial and energy stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May Remain Rangebound On Tuesday
events.description: The China stock market has finished lower in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had collected almost 20 points or 0.5 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,800-point plateau and it's likely to remain in that neighborhood again on Tuesday.

events.title: Tech Shares May Weigh On Taiwan Stock Market
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, sinking more than 520 points or 1.1 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above he 49,300-point plateau and it may spin its wheels again on Tuesday.

events.title: Japan Overall Bank Lending Rises 5.3% On Year In September
events.description: The total value of overall bank lending in Japan was up 5.3 percent on year in September, the Bank of Japan said on Tuesday - coming in at 681.974 trillion yen.
